title: Source robustness and predictive uncertainty of two stroke lesion segmentation models: a 762-case public benchmark - reproducibility archive
description: Reproducibility archive for a fixed-denominator, same-cohort evaluation of two immutable stroke lesion segmentation pipelines on 762 publicly released T1-weighted MRI cases. Version 2.0 preserves the original prespecified inconclusive source-stratum result and adds a complete comparison with SynthStroke, probability calibration, uncertainty-error association, risk-coverage analysis, and performance-blinded qualitative examples. The archive contains code, frozen protocols and amendments, aggregate non-identifying results, figure source data, and reproducibility receipts. It excludes patient-level images, masks, predictions, probability arrays, complete case-level metrics, source filenames, worker assignments, and subject-to-center linkage records.
